description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionController class, which handles the user interface logic for managing US tax exemptions within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base controller, fetches necessary services, and sets up Vue.js components with relevant data and permissions.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionController
classes.description: Controller class managing US tax exemption data and permissions for employee UI within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Retrieves the CountryService instance for fetching province data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets Vue.js components with employee tax exemption data and user permissions before rendering.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for permission checks related to tax exemptions.
